i.norm:
Verifies that negating and then taking the absolute value of {@code Weeks.ONE} returns to the original positive amount.

Negating {@code ONE} (1 week) yields -1 weeks, and taking the absolute value of -1 weeks restores 1 week. Since {@link Weeks#abs()} returns a positive amount and {@link Weeks#of(int)} reuses the {@link Weeks#ONE} singleton for a value of 1, the result is the very same instance as {@code Weeks.ONE}.
